description: Search Austria's consolidated federal law (Bundesrecht konsolidiert) by full-text words, by law title, or by law number (Gesetzesnummer). Returns matching provisions (§/Art/Anlage) with their law, citation, in-force dates (in_force_from/in_force_until kept separate from publication), subject index and the official RIS page URL. Pass in_force_on (YYYY-MM-DD) to search the version valid on that date (default: today). Source: Bundeskanzleramt (Austria), Rechtsinformationssystem (RIS), Bundesrecht konsolidiert. Pass gesetzesnummer + a provision number to at_get_provision for the actual text.

gesetzesnummer.description: Exact RIS law number, e.g. "10001622" (ABGB), if already known.

in_force_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD — restrict to the version in force on this date (default: today).

limit.description: Max results per page, 1-100 (default 20; snapped to RIS page sizes 10/20/50/100).

titel.description: Words to match in the law's title, e.g. "Datenschutzgesetz".

name: at_search_legislation
title: At Search Legislation
